scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Lecter, you should thank the adventurer first.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
萊克特，你應該先謝謝冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think he's too busy stirring the juice to hear you. It's okay. I didn't do this to get thanked. He really must love it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得他正忙著攪拌果汁，可能聽不見。沒關係。我做這些不是為了得到感謝。他真的很喜歡這個。

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Yes, I love it! A lot! Heh heh! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[小 萊克特]
是的，我很喜歡！非常喜歡！嘿嘿！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
唉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's happy. Why are you sighing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他看起來很開心。你為什麼要嘆氣呢？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Watching him so happy to drink that fake juice reminds me of the real agave juice I used to drink when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
看著他這麼開心地喝著那種假果汁，讓我想起了年輕時喝過的真正的龍舌蘭果汁。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
It wasn't factory-made powder. Real agave juice took so much time and effort to make that we only drank it on special occasions.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
那不是工廠生產的粉末。真正的龍舌蘭果汁製作起來非常耗時費力，所以我們只在特殊的場合才會喝。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
On those days, my whole family would gather around and make agave juice together. We'd also grill steaks wrapped in agave leaves, and sometimes relatives from far away would also visit us to play music and dance together all night.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
在那樣的日子裡，全家人都會聚在一起製作龍舌蘭果汁。我們還會用龍舌蘭葉子包裹牛排進行燒烤，有時遠房親戚也會來拜訪，大家一起唱歌跳舞直到深夜。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I had so much fun as a child, but my child never got to experience any of that. Nowadays, everyone's just too busy to gather or stay up all night, singing and dancing.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
我小時候過得很快樂，但我的孩子從未體驗過那樣的生活。如今，大家都太忙了，沒有時間去聚會，也沒有時間徹夜歌唱和舞蹈。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But we Cacti want to preserve our traditions as best we can, to teach them to our children.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
但我們仙人掌族希望能儘可能保留這些傳統，並將它們傳授給我們的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Ah, I've talked too much. I'm sorry I took up your time, Adventurer.
Thank you. Please take this. It's not much, but I hope you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
啊，我說了太多話。抱歉佔用了您的時間，冒險者。
謝謝您。請收下這個。雖然不多，但我希望您會喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
And if you're not busy, could you come back and hunt some more coyotes? There've been more coyotes lately than before. They're part of nature, just like we are, but they're threatening our safety.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
如果您不忙的話，能回來再幫我獵殺一些寇猶鐵嗎？最近寇猶鐵比以前更多了。它們也是自然界的一部分，就像我們一樣，但它們正在威脅我們的安全。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I may not be able to give my son real agave juice, but I at least want to be able to go buy things he wants.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
我可能無法給我的兒子真正的龍舌蘭果汁，但我至少希望能有能力買到他想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I'll appreciate if you can help me every day, starting from today.
I'll really appreciate if you can help for a little longer. You inspire me to try harder to make a better life for my son.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
如果您能從今天開始，每天都幫幫我，我會非常感激。
如果您能再多堅持一段時間，我會更加感激。您激勵著我更努力地生活，為我的兒子創造更好的未來。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You need to stop what you're doing and look at it sometimes, or you'll miss important details.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
有時候你需要停下手中的工作，抬頭看看周圍，否則你會錯過重要的細節。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
As always, I'm grateful for your help, but you need to come back in the morning. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
一如既往，我很感激您的幫助，但您需要明天早上再來。謝謝。

scripts.text:
Strange Adventurer, thank you for coming back.
You came to hunt coyotes for me, right?
scripts.translation:
奇怪的冒險者，謝謝你回來。
你是來幫我獵殺寇猶鐵的吧？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, I came to talk.
scripts.translation: 不，我是來聊天的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You're not as busy as usual, huh?
I'm not too busy myself either, thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
你看起來不像平時那麼忙啊。
多虧了你，我自己也不太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Having something to do is a blessing.
We wake up in the morning, work to repay nature's gifts, and go to bed at night.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
有事可做是一種福氣。
我們早上醒來，工作以回報自然的饋贈，晚上睡覺。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But of course, you need time to rest, like now. Working all day and not resting makes one's life dull.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
但當然，你也需要休息的時間，就像現在這樣。整天工作而不休息，生活會變得枯燥乏味。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
As always, please hunt ^0000CD30 Coyotes^000000 for me.
Every night, they show up in groups, yipping as if to say we'd never be able to get rid of all of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
一如既往，請幫我獵殺^0000CD30只寇猶鐵^000000。
每天晚上，它們成群結隊地出現，嘰嘰喳喳地叫，好像在說我們永遠也消滅不完它們。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But I believe one small change a day can eventually make a huge difference.
And you're making it possible. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡克圖隆夫人]
但我相信，每天的一點小改變，最終能帶來巨大的不同。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: - 我拿到了龍舌蘭口味果汁袋，但我覺得威脅他拿到它讓我很內疚。 -

May the sun and earth
bless you.
scripts.translation:

你好。
願太陽與大地
保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
You're one of those strangers from a far land.
I'm Crouched Horse,
a brave warrior of the Cacti.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
你是來自遠方的陌生人之一。
我是蜷伏的馬，
仙人掌族的勇士。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]

Did you find the ore fragments I asked?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]

scripts.text:

For now,
I don't need more ores.
But I will
when the sun comes up tomorrow.
scripts.translation:

暫時，
我不需要更多礦石了。
但明天
太陽昇起時我會需要。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]

I'm running out of
the ores.
Say, could you
help me again?
scripts.translation:

那個，你能

scripts.translation: [蜷伏的馬]

先回去
幫助你的村莊安定下來吧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
You've resolved
one of the greatest challenges your village faced.
I applaud you for your bravery and wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
你解決了
你們村莊面臨的最大挑戰之一。
我敬佩你的勇氣與智慧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
If you're not busy,
could you also help my village?
It's not difficult.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
如果你不忙的話，
能也幫幫我的村莊嗎？
這並不難。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 我能為你做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
This place
has been
our home
for many,
many generations.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
這個地方
已經是我們
許多、
許多代人的家園了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
And for a long time,
we lived in harmony with nature.
Then a few years ago
you came from a far land.
Your way of life
was different from ours.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
很長一段時間以來，
我們與自然和諧共處。
直到幾年前，
你們從遠方而來。
你們的生活方式
與我們的不同。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
We repay Nature
for her gifts,
and we don't take
more than we need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
我們回報自然
給予我們的恩賜，
我們不會索取
超過需要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
But you do.
You liked to
take more things
than what you need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
但你們會。
你們喜歡
索取比需要的
更多的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Because we're greedy,
- and I'm ashamed of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 因為我們貪婪，
- 我為此感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
I'm not trying to blame you.
It's just that
you take so much
that there's
nothing left
for us.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
我並不是要責怪你們。
只是你們
索取太多，
以至於
留給我們
的所剩無幾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- What do you need?
- How can I help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 你們需要什麼？
- 我該如何幫忙？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
If you find purple ore fragments
while exploring this land,
I'd like you to
bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
如果你在探索這片土地時
發現了紫羅蘭礦石碎片，
我希望你能
把它們帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Since you opened the mine,
we've been having a hard time
finding the ores.
Say, can you do that?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
自從你們開採了礦場，
我們就很難找到礦石了。
請問，你能幫我們做這件事嗎？

scripts.text: Mm, not now.
scripts.translation: 嗯，現在不行。

scripts.text: Sure thing. I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。我馬上回來。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, I see.
Hm... I understand.
You can come back when you're not busy.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
哦，我明白了。
嗯...我理解。
等你不忙的時候再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, thank you!
You can find
purple ore fragments
while hunting in this area.
Just bring me 10. That's all I need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
哦，謝謝你！
你可以在這個區域狩獵時
找到紫羅蘭礦石碎片。
只要帶給我10個就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Thank you.
May the sun and earth bless you!
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
謝謝。
願太陽和大地保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hm, you don't have
all of them.
You can find them
from coyotes
and the Buffalo Bandits.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
嗯，你還沒有
集齊所有碎片。
你可以從寇猶鐵
和野牛強盜身上找到它們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Yes, I did.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 是的，我做到了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
I don't feel good about
having to sacrifice
others
for my own sake.
Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
為了我自己的利益
而犧牲他人，
讓我感到很不舒服。
謝謝你為我做了這件事。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Please take this small token of my appreciation.
I've received it from your village,
and I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
請收下這份小小的心意。
這是我從你們村莊那裡得到的，
我不需要它。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hm, you've brought
more than
I asked.
I know you mean well,
but I don't need so many.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
嗯，你帶來的
比我要求的
還要多。
我知道你是好意，
但我不需要這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Next time,
please just bring
as many as I ask.
But thanks.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
下次，
請只帶
我要求數量的礦石。
不過還是謝謝了。

scripts.text: Not this time.
scripts.translation: 這次不行。

scripts.text: Sure thing. It'd be my pleasure.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。我很樂意。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, I see.
Hm... I understand.
Feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
哦，我明白了。
嗯...我理解。
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, thank you!
You're as reliable as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的馬]
哦，謝謝你！
你果然像我想像的那樣可靠。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了。我應該先減輕背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Oh, I close today. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
哦，我今天打烊了。明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Nice to meet you.
I'm Abraham Iven Hudin. I'm originally from different country.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
很高興見到你。
我是亞伯拉罕·伊文·胡丁。我來自另一個國家。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
So you have things that I might have interest in on buying?
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
所以，你有我可能感興趣購買的東西嗎？

scripts.text: What kinds of things?
scripts.translation: 什麼樣的東西？

scripts.text: I'm not selling anything!
scripts.translation: 我不賣任何東西！

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Whoa, whoa! Adventurer is violent. I not do business with barbarians.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
哎呀，哎呀！這位冒險者好凶啊。我不跟野蠻人做生意。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
I travels the world and bought valuable things. This time I collecting specialty products of this new continent.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
我遊歷世界，購買珍貴的物品。這次，我正在收集這個新大陸的特色產品。

scripts.text: (I can barely understand his English.)
scripts.translation: （我幾乎聽不懂他的英語。）

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm? What have you said?
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
嗯？你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text: Nothing. Go on.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。請繼續。

scripts.text: I said I can't understand what you're saying.
scripts.translation: 我說我聽不懂你在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Adventurer have a cold heart!
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
這位冒險者好冷漠啊！

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Anyway, I looking for things that can only find in this place. If you found them, gimme them.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
總之，我在找只有這裡才有的東西。如果你找到了，就賣給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
I'll pay you good. You welcomes all the time.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
我會給你很好的價格。隨時歡迎你來。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
What have you brought my today?
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
你今天給我帶來了什麼？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm, do you want your things back?
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
嗯，你想把東西拿回去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm? Where are they? The things you said will give me.
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
嗯？東西呢？你說過要給我的那些東西。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
It good business. These I didn't see anywhere else. I like them very much!
scripts.translation:
[異域商人]
這筆買賣不錯。我在別處都沒見過這些。我很喜歡！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了。我應該先減輕背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
What? I don't have enough food for you!
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
什麼？我沒有足夠的食物給你！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Hey, don't you see the line over there? I don't care who you are? go stand in line if you want to eat.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
嘿，你沒看到那邊的隊伍嗎？不管你是誰，想吃就給我去排隊。

scripts.text: I'm not here to eat.
scripts.translation: 我不是來吃飯的。

scripts.text: I'll stand in line.
scripts.translation: 我去排隊。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
*Snort* You'd better.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
*哼* 你最好這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
You're not here to eat. Err, is that...? Ah, my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
你不是來吃飯的。呃，那是...？啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Wait, then why are you bothering me? Can't you see I'm upset because of the missing shipment?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
等等，那你來找我幹嘛？難道你沒看到我因為貨物丟失而心煩意亂嗎？

scripts.text: What missing shipment?
scripts.translation: 什麼貨物丟失了？

scripts.text: That's your business.
scripts.translation: 那是你的事。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
嘖，你真是個混蛋。我沒時間跟你廢話。快滾！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Look at that. Those people have been waiting for their food for hours. How can I tell them that I don't have enough ingredients to cook for them?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
你看那些人。他們已經等了好幾個小時了。我該怎麼告訴他們，我沒有足夠的食材來給他們做飯呢？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
The food ingredients that were supposed to come from Midgard didn't arrive, and I can't keep these people waiting.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
本來應該從米德加爾特送來的食材沒有到，我不能讓這些人一直等下去。

scripts.text: Why don't you procure some ingredients from the outside?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼不從外面採購一些食材？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 聽到這個很遺憾。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
嘖，你真是個混蛋。我沒時間跟你廢話。快滾！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I thought about it. I was desperate enough to try anything.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
我考慮過了。我當時走投無路，什麼辦法都試了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
But there are only sand and rocks out there, and nothing edible. I can't believe I thought I could run a kitchen in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
但外面只有沙子和岩石，沒有任何可吃的東西。我真不敢相信我竟然想過在這種地方開廚房。

scripts.text:
[Hungry Laborer]
^990000Wait, did you just say you have no ingredients? You ran out of them?^000000
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的勞工]
^990000等等，你剛才說沒有食材了嗎？你用完它們了？^000000

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
^990000No, I didn't say that! It's just taking a little longer to cook today. Stop panicking!^000000
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
^990000不，我沒這麼說！只是今天做飯需要的時間稍微長一點。別驚慌！^000000

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫忙。

scripts.text: Good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
嘖，你真是個混蛋。我沒時間跟你廢話。快滾！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
You can help. How?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
你可以幫忙。怎麼幫？

scripts.text: You need food ingredients, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你需要食材，對吧？

scripts.text: That depends on you.
scripts.translation: 那得看你。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Alright, then let's do this. I'll jot down everything I need. Can you bring them from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
好吧，那就這麼辦。我會把需要的東西都記下來。你能從米德加爾特把它們帶過來嗎？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text: It'd be a waste of my time if I say no now.
scripts.translation: 現在說“不”就太浪費我的時間了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Good! We've made a deal. I need some time to take inventory. Talk to me again later.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
很好！我們成交了。我需要一點時間清點庫存。稍後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
今天這些應該就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Aww, here's the list of ingredients I need. Bring them quickly, will you?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
哎呀，這是我需要的食材清單。請快點把它們帶過來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Oh, come on. Help me out here. People are starving.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
拜託了，幫個忙吧。大家都快餓死了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Sweet potato croquettes are on the menu today, and I can't make them because I didn't get the regular shipment from the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
今天的選單是紅薯可樂餅，但我沒收到來自大陸的常規貨物，做不了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶160個{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
There are so many mouths to feed, and yet I've got no meat? This is disaster!
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
這麼多人要吃飯，我卻一點肉都沒有？這可糟了！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
What? I could always feed them veggies, you say? Sure, but all they want is meat.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
什麼？你說我可以喂他們蔬菜？當然可以，但他們只想要肉。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 50 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶50個{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Have you seen the carrots growing in the garden in the back?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
你看到後面花園裡種的胡蘿蔔了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
They're as thin as fingers, and once I almost put my fingers into a stew instead of them.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
它們細得像手指，有一次我差點把手指放進燉湯裡，而不是胡蘿蔔。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶160個{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I shouldn't have put that banana bread on the menu. Who knew they wouldn't arrive in time?
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
我不該把香蕉麵包列入選單的。誰知道它們會遲到呢？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶160個{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I have to cook a pumpkin stew, but I don't have pumpkins. This is the equivalent of making toast without bread.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
我得做南瓜湯，但我沒有南瓜。這就像沒有面包卻要做吐司一樣。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶160個{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
The only thing I can cook with the ingredients I have is mushroom soup, but I don't have the main ingredient: mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
用我現有的食材，只能做蘑菇湯，但我沒有主要食材：蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 60 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶60個{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me {0} {1} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
請從米德加爾特給我帶{0}個{1}。你可以在大城市的商人那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Whew, thank you. This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物分發員]
呼，謝謝你。今天這些應該就夠了。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了。我應該先減輕背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Sorry, but we need someone stronger than you.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
抱歉，我們需要比你更強壯的人。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Hey, buddy. You look pretty strong. You're here to work, right?
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
嘿，夥計。你看起來挺強壯的。你是來工作的吧？

scripts.text: No. I'm just a tourist.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是個遊客。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Come on, don't be so heartless. I'm trying to strike up a conversation here. I've got a proposition that you might be interested. What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
拜託，別這麼無情嘛。我只是想搭個話。我有個提議，你可能會感興趣。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Alright, let me hear it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，讓我聽聽。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Oh, you don't. *Smacks his lips* How disappointing!
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
哦，你不感興趣。*咂了咂嘴* 真讓人失望！

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Ah, so you're not as snobbish as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
啊，看來你並沒有我想像中那麼勢利。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
For Rock Ridge to become a transport hub, the monsters that live around it have got to go, but we can't find the right people for the job.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
為了讓洛克理奇成為交通樞紐，必須清除周圍居住的魔物，但我們找不到合適的人手。

scripts.text: What about all these people?
scripts.translation: 那這些人呢？

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
*Snort* These? Yeah, we thought they were good enough until we realized how strong the monsters out there were.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
*哼* 這些人？是啊，我們本來以為他們夠格，直到發現外面的魔物有多強。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
None of these guys would come back alive, let alone earn their keep. And then we'd have to go out there to collect their remains, which is doubly bad for us.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
這些人沒有一個能活著回來，更別提能勝任工作了。然後我們還得出門去收屍，這對我們來說更是雪上加霜。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Then I saw you, and you stood out like a wolf among sheep. That is, you've passed! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
然後我看到了你，你就像羊群中的狼一樣出眾。也就是說，你通過了！恭喜！

scripts.text: I never said I wanted to work with you.
scripts.translation: 我可沒說想跟你合作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Ah, come on, don't be like that. Help this poor man out here.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
哎呀，別這樣嘛。幫幫這個可憐人吧。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Okay, okay, I understand if you're busy. But I'm offering you benefits both of us.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
好吧好吧，我理解你很忙。但我提供的待遇對雙方都有好處。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
How about I show you the list of things you could do for us? If you're interested, come back later. I promise I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
這樣吧，我讓你看看你可以為我們做哪些事。如果你感興趣，稍後再來找我。我保證會給你豐厚的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The worst is over. I'll need your help again. Save your energy until then, alright?
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
最糟糕的時期已經過去了。之後我還需要你的幫助。在那之前，請儲存好你的體力，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你忘了你要做什麼了嗎？那麼，我再告訴你一次。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
這裡周圍田野裡最大的威脅是野牛強盜。他們聰明且殘忍，不聽任何道理。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
而且他們時不時地入侵這個村莊，彷彿在試探我們能堅持多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits with rifles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
我們想殺雞儆猴，讓他們收斂點。消滅^0000ff15持有步槍的野牛強盜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
這裡周圍田野裡最大的威脅是野牛強盜。他們聰明且殘忍，不聽任何道理。

scripts.text:

And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
而且他們時不時地入侵這個村莊，彷彿在試探我們能堅持多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits wearing red masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
我們想殺雞儆猴，讓他們收斂點。消滅^0000ff15戴著紅色面具的野牛強盜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
這裡周圍田野裡最大的威脅是野牛強盜。他們聰明且殘忍，不聽任何道理。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
而且他們時不時地入侵這個村莊，彷彿在試探我們能堅持多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
我們想殺雞儆猴，讓他們收斂點。消滅^0000ff15戴著獨眼龍眼罩的野牛強盜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你忘了你要做什麼了嗎？那麼，我再告訴你一次。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The Cacti and the members of this village are on good terms, and recently more coyotes have been seen along the road that leads to their village.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
仙人掌和這個村莊的成員關係很好，但最近通往他們村莊的路上出現了越來越多的寇猶鐵。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Coyotes aren't aggressive, but they still keep the Cacti from coming in and out of their village freely.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
寇猶鐵雖然不具攻擊性，但它們仍然阻礙著仙人掌自由進出村莊。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Please hunt ^0000ff20 Coyotes^000000 and help our friends.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
請狩獵^0000ff20寇猶鐵^000000，幫助我們的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The workers who were sent down to the basement of the village went missing one after another, so we investigated. We believe they were killed by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
派往村莊地下的工人接連失蹤，我們對此進行了調查。我們認為他們是死於魔物之手。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Swamp Arclouzes are fast, carnivorous insects living down there, and their number has been increasing at such an alarming rate that workers now refuse to go in there to work.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
沼澤卷甲蟲是生活在那裡的快速肉食性昆蟲，它們的數量正以驚人的速度增長，工人們現在都拒絕進去工作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
If you have business down there, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffSwamp Arclouzes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
如果你要去那裡辦事，請消滅10只^0000ff沼澤卷甲蟲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The bodies of the workers who went missing in the basement have been found. They were mangled so badly that even their families had a hard time recognizing them.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
在地下失蹤的工人的屍體已經被找到了。他們被撕咬得面目全非，連家人都很難辨認出來。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
I think they were killed by brown rats that thrive in the basement. Rumor has it they even attack living people, and if it holds true, that's serious.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
我想他們是死於在地下繁衍生息的沼澤藍鼠。傳聞它們甚至會攻擊活人，如果這是真的，那就很嚴重了。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
If you have business in the basement, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffBrown Rats^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
如果你要去地下辦事，請消滅10只^0000ff沼澤藍鼠^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're amazing? I didn't know you could really do this! Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你太厲害了！我不知道你真的能做到！謝謝！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了。我應該先減輕背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Hah hah, thank you for your interest, but we're not desperate enough to need help from little kids like you.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
哈哈，謝謝你的好意，但我們還沒到需要像你這樣的小孩幫忙的地步。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou must be Level 140 or above to receive this quest.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你必須達到140級才能接受這個任務。^000000

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Mm? You're not one of us. If you need a job, then you should look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
嗯？你不是我們的人。如果你需要工作，應該去別處找找。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你很棒。我很樂意再次與你合作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're pretty strong. Can you handle something tough?
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你很強。你能處理一些棘手的事情嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Alright, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
好的，請慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你忘了你要做什麼了嗎？那麼，我再告訴你一次。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
[菁英]巡邏牛仔是野牛強盜中的首領，這次的任務就是關於他們的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the buffaloes with rifles before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those with ^0000ffglowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你之前用步槍對付過野牛強盜，對吧？那你一定見過那些^0000ff眼睛發著藍光^000000的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of rifle buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffrifle Buffalo Bandits with glowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
它們是持槍野牛強盜的中層軍官。我要你消滅10只^0000ff眼睛發著藍光的持槍野牛強盜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
[菁英]巡邏牛仔是野牛強盜中的首領，這次的任務就是關於他們的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the masked buffaloes before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffgreen masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你之前對付過戴面具的野牛強盜，對吧？那你一定見過那些戴著^0000ff綠色面具^000000的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of masked buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing green masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
它們是戴面具野牛強盜的中層軍官。我要你消滅10只^0000ff戴著綠色面具的野牛強盜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
[菁英]巡邏牛仔是野牛強盜中的首領，這次的任務就是關於他們的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the buffaloes with an eye patch before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffpale green vests^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你之前對付過戴獨眼龍眼罩的野牛強盜，對吧？那你一定見過那些穿著^0000ff淺綠色背心^000000的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of sword buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch and a pale green vest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
它們是持劍野牛強盜的中層軍官。我要你消滅10只^0000ff戴著獨眼龍眼罩和淺綠色背心的野牛強盜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Some miners have reported to us about gas-like monsters that spread a neurotoxin.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
有礦工向我們報告，說有一種散發神經毒素的瓦斯狀魔物。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're purple monsters named Gasters. They don't attack unless they're provoked, but they still pose a threat.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
它們是名為瓦斯魔的紫色魔物。除非被挑釁，否則不會主動攻擊，但依然具有威脅性。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Please hunt 10 ^0000ffGasters^000000 in the mine outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
請在村莊外的礦場討伐10只^0000ff瓦斯魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation:
[鋼鐵義警]
你很棒。我很樂意再次與你合作。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了。我應該先減輕背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
What are you doing here? You're not good enough to earn your keep. Out!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
你在這裡做什麼？你這種水平連工資都掙不回來。滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
My office is filled with thieves. Everyone expects to be paid? Without doing their job!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
我的辦公室全是小偷。每個人都想拿工資？卻不幹活！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
And you. How much were you going to ask me for? Just so you know, we don't allow payroll advances.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
還有你。你打算找我要多少錢？告訴你，我們不允許預支工資。

scripts.text: I'm just a passersby.
scripts.translation: 我只是個路人。

scripts.text: I want 100 million Zeny in advance.
scripts.translation: 我想預支1億Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
...
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
...

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You're out of your mind.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
你瘋了吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Mm? But you look too strong to be a simple passersby.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
嗯？但你看起來太強了，不像是個普通的路人。

scripts.text: Well, I don't have any business here. I should go.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我沒什麼事。我該走了。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
WAIT!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
站住！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Wait. Yes.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
等等。是的。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hey, Jamie! How many more workers did you say we need in the culvert?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
嘿，傑米！你說下水道還需要多少工人？

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
^000077Since 2 more disappeared yesterday, 15. No one wants to go down there.^000000
scripts.translation:
[傑米]
^000077昨天又消失了2個，所以是15個。沒人願意去那裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hear that? Our office is severely understaffed.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
聽到了嗎？我們辦公室嚴重人手不足。

scripts.text: But what about all these people who are eager to work?
scripts.translation: 但是那些急著找工作的人呢？

scripts.text: Not my business.
scripts.translation: 不關我的事。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hey, come on! I'm not finished!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
嘿，別走啊！我還沒說完呢！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
They're eager, all right, but none of them is strong enough to be useful.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
他們確實很積極，但沒一個強壯到能派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We need a lot of people at a construction site. It's... a little bit dangerous down there, but you look like you know how to deal with danger.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
建築工地需要很多人手。那裡...有點危險，但你看起來像是知道如何應對危險的人。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Say, how'd you like to work for me? I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
喂，你願意為我工作嗎？我會給你豐厚的報酬。

scripts.text: Tell me what this job entails.
scripts.translation: 告訴我這份工作的具體內容。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You don't have to think! This benefits both of us!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
不用想那麼多！這對我們雙方都有利！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
讓我給你介紹一下這個村莊。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遺蹟之上。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
我們不能完全填滿地下室，因為那裡安裝著我們的海水淡化系統。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
讓我給你介紹一下這個村莊。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遺蹟之上。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
我們不能完全填滿地下室，因為那裡安裝著我們的海水淡化系統。

scripts.text: Can't you get water elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 不能從別處獲取水源嗎？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
This area is a desert. Desalinating is cheaper than importing water.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
這片區域是沙漠。海水淡化的成本比進口淡水要低。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Anyway, the desalination system itself is in good order, but the cobweb of pipes that forms the system is prone to erosion and breakage. They need constant maintenance.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
總之，海水淡化系統本身運轉正常，但構成系統的管道網路容易受到侵蝕和損壞。它們需要持續維護。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Then some time ago, monsters started showing up in the basement, and now our workers are too scared to work. That's the situation we're in right now.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
然後前段時間，地下室開始出現魔物，現在我們的工人嚇得不敢工作了。這就是我們目前的狀況。

scripts.text: What happens if I say no?
scripts.translation: 如果我拒絕會怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
This village will run out of drinking water. Someone has to do this. Believe it or not, I'm doing doing this entirely for profit.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
這個村莊會斷水。總得有人去做這件事。信不信由你，我完全是為了利潤才這麼做的。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Say, is that good enough motivation for you? If you still don't want to help us, I won't force you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
喂，這理由夠充分了嗎？如果你還是不想幫我們的忙，我也不會勉強你。

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
^000077Mr. Chairman, I've just got a call from the basement. Five more workers have been attacked by monsters.^000000
scripts.translation:
[傑米]
^000077會長先生，我剛接到地下室的電話。又有5名工人被魔物襲擊了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Uh-oh, I'd better go take care of that situation. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
糟糕，我得去處理一下那裡的情況。如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Aren't you tired? The pipes don't need cleaning at this moment. Why don't you go take care of whatever else you have to do?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
你不累嗎？現在管道不需要清潔。你不妨先去處理其他事情？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Does this mean you're willing to go downstairs?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
這是意味著你願意去地下室嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Alright, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
好的，慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Good. Let me tell you what to do. Take a look at the door at the bottom of the water storage to the left side of me. It's connected to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
很好。讓我告訴你該怎麼做。看看我左邊儲水塔底部的那扇門。它連線著地下室。

scripts.text: Do you mean the door that looks like a portal?
scripts.translation: 你是說那扇看起來像傳送門的門嗎？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Yes. Usually it's closed, and only those who have business in the basement can use it,
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
是的。通常它是關閉的，只有需要在地下室工作的人才能使用。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You know, people who help the Vigilantes, clean the sewer, and maintain the desalination pipes, like you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
你知道的，比如幫助義警、清理下水道、維護淡化管道的人，就像你一樣。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Your job is to find four different types of pipes and fasten their bolts to prevent leakage.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
你的任務是找到四種不同型別的管道，並擰緊它們的螺栓以防止洩漏。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
The pipes that need maintenance are colored differently for easy recognition. When you're ready, enter the door on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
需要維護的管道顏色不同，以便於識別。準備好了就進入左邊的門吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You haven't finished cleaning the pipes. We'll run out of water soon. Could you hurry up?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
你還沒清理完管道。我們很快就會沒水了。能快點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Good job. The villagers can enjoy clean water for the rest of the day, and it's all because of you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化設施管理員]
幹得好。村民們今天剩下的時間都能喝上乾淨的水，這都多虧了你。

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
Could you stop hitting on me? I'm the Chairman's personal secretary.
scripts.translation:
[傑米]
你能不能別對我動手動腳了？我是會長的私人秘書。

scripts.text: ^0000ffWarning: This place is not for the weak or faint-hearted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff警告：此地不適合膽小或意志薄弱者。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffDo you want to move to the underground village?^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你要移動到地下村莊嗎？^000000

scripts.text: Move.
scripts.translation: 移動

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再說

scripts.text: You have decided not to use the underground passage.
scripts.translation: 你決定不使用地下通道。

scripts.text: ^0000ffDo you want to go above ground?^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你要回到地面嗎？^000000

scripts.text: Move.
scripts.translation: 移動

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再說

scripts.text: You have decided not to use the menu.
scripts.translation: 你決定不使用選單。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You're one of the adventurers from the mainland, right?
My name is Donovan,
sewer system manager.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
你是來自大陸的冒險者之一，對吧？
我叫多諾萬，
是下水道系統管理員。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
The pipes are
clear of sea anemones at this moment.
Why don't you
come back later?
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
目前管道里
沒有沙漠向日葵。
你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Ah, welcome back!
I've been thinking
it's time to
get rid of sea anemones again.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
啊，歡迎回來！
我一直在想，
是時候
再次清除沙漠向日葵了。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, so you're
the adventurer who took care of the Buffalo Bandits!
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
哦，原來你就是
解決野牛強盜問題的冒險者！
很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Go east,
and you'll see Joe.
He'll let you
go down to the basement
if you tell him I sent you.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
往東走，
你會看到喬。
告訴他是我派你來的，
他就會讓你去地下室。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Ah, Adventurer, welcome back.
How was it, getting rid of sea anemones?
It wasn't too difficult, was it?
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
啊，冒險者，歡迎回來。
清除沙漠向日葵的感覺如何？
應該不太難吧？

scripts.text: [Donovan]
scripts.translation: [多諾萬]

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
There are so many problems
the Buffalo Bandits, the mine, just to name a couple?
that no one else cares about their own sewer system right now.
The Buffalo Bandits
need to be taken care of first.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
野牛強盜、米內，光是這兩樣就夠讓人頭疼了，
現在根本沒人顧得上自己的下水道系統。
野牛強盜的問題得先解決。

scripts.text: I can do that.
scripts.translation: 我可以去處理。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, I see.
I understand.
But come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
哦，我明白了。
我理解。
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You know how to enter the basement, right?
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
你知道怎麼進入地下室，對吧？
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
So, you're strong enough to
take care of the bandits.
Would you be so kind
as to help me with something?
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
看來你的實力足以
對付那些強盜。
能請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Alright, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 好的，有什麼我可以幫你的？

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, where are my manners?
My name is Donovan,
sewer system manager.
I manage the underground water pump
and sewage system.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
哎呀，失禮了。
我叫多諾萬，
是下水道系統管理員。
我負責管理地下水泵
和排汙系統。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Groundwater keeps welling up
from the basement of the village,
and it has to be pumped out into the sea
to prevent flooding.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
地下水不斷從村莊的地下室湧出，
必須將其泵入海中，
以防止洪水氾濫。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
My job is to make sure
the pumps and sewage system are
in working order
at all times,
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
我的工作是確保
水泵和排汙系統
始終處於
正常工作狀態，

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
and it's not a job for just one man.
There are so many things to do
that I need help.
The work itself isn't complicated.
Could you help me?
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
而且這並非一人之力所能勝任。
要做的事情太多了，
我需要人手。
工作本身並不複雜。
你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, I see.
I understand.
But come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
哦，我明白了。
我理解。
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Wow, thank you!
All you have to do is
go down to the basement
and get rid of sea anemones
on the pipes and water pump.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
哇，謝謝你！
你只需要
去地下室，
清除管道和水泵上的
沙漠向日葵即可。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You can go down to the basement
by talking to
Joe, who's a bit east of here.
He'll let you
go down to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
你可以找喬進入地下室，
他就在東邊不遠處。
他會讓你
進入地下室的。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
We call him Quiet Joe.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
我們叫他“沉默的喬”。
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- No, it wasn't.
- It was boring, though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 不，不難。
- 不過挺無聊的。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Hah hah, it's a boring job, sure.
But it must not be boring to those sea anemones
because they spring up every day,
no matter how hard I try
to keep them in check.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
哈哈，這工作確實無聊。
但對那些沙漠向日葵來說肯定不無聊，
因為它們每天都冒出來，
無論我多麼努力
想要控制它們。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Getting rid of them
takes up a lot of my time.
Thank you for your help.
I could always use help getting rid of sea anemones.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[多諾萬]
清除它們
佔用了我大量的時間。
謝謝你的幫助。
清除沙漠向日葵時，我隨時都需要人手。
請再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
What are you looking at? Scram before I put holes in your face! Git!
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
看什麼看？滾開，不然我打爛你的臉！滾蛋！

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I should go. He's just being stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我該走了。他只是太固執了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Frankly, I don't understand why he would want to do this, but I don't want to stop him.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
說實話，我不明白他為什麼非要這麼做，
但我不想阻止他。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Midnight]
Demon, some strange kid is just hanging out around us. Do you know him?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
惡魔，有個奇怪的小孩一直在我們附近徘徊。
你認識他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Who? Where? I don't see him. Send him to me.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
誰？在哪裡？我沒看見他。
讓他過來找我。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You're carrying so much stuff, I'm worried you might break your shoulder. Why don't you go lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你背了這麼多東西，
我擔心你會傷到肩膀。
不如先去把包裡的東西整理一下？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You're still wet behind the ears. This place is too dangerous for you. Come back later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你還嫩得很。
這裡太危險了，不適合你。
改天再來吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You have no idea how dangerous this place is, do you? Get out of here while you can.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你根本不知道這裡有多危險，對吧？
趁現在還能走，趕緊離開吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You came back quickly. Ah, I miss being young.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你回來得真快。
啊，真懷念年輕的時候。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
But look, I still have left some of the materials you brought me yesterday. I can't use all these.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不過你看，
昨天你帶給我的一些材料我還沒用完。
我沒法一次性用完這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why don't you go home and come back next morning?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不如你先回家，明天早上再來？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, kiddo! It's very nice to see you again. The bomb I made with the materials you brought is in the aging process. Did you know wine and bombs get better the older they are?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
嘿，小傢伙！
很高興再次見到你。
我用你帶來的材料做的炸彈正在陳化中。
你知道吧，酒和炸彈都是越陳越好的？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Now, could you bring some more materials today? We're a long way from having all the bombs we need.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
那麼，今天能再帶些材料來嗎？
我們離湊齊所需的炸彈數量還差得遠呢。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
As usual, get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
照舊，去弄 ^0000cd10劇毒粉 和 1 個炸彈粉末^000000，
還有 ^0000cdhunt 15 只瓦斯魔^000000。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We'll be counting on you, kiddo!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我們就指望你了，小傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Alright, this should do. You know what I need, right? Are you sure you could sneak in? Maybe I should go.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
好了，這應該夠了。
你知道我需要什麼，對吧？
你確定你能潛進去嗎？
也許我該親自去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I'll go while everyone's in bed.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
等大家都睡了我就去。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
But the noise could wake them up. There'll be guards, too.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
但動靜太大可能會吵醒他們。
而且那裡會有衛兵。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I'll be alright. We all look alike? They won't know I'm not one of them.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
沒關係的。我們長得都很像，
他們不會發現我不是他們的人。

scripts.text: Mister, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 先生，您在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
*Glance*
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
*瞥了一眼*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you playing with fire in the middle of nowhere? You're suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們為什麼在荒郊野外玩火？
你們很可疑。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Hey, a kid is asking you a question. He looks so curious that I'm worried he might die if you don't tell him.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
嘿，有個小孩在問你問題。
他看起來好奇得要命，
要是你不告訴他，
我怕他會急死。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Little kids like him are full of curiosity. You'd better tell him before he starts crying.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
像他這樣的小孩子好奇心都很重。
你最好告訴他，
不然他就要哭了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Yo tell him.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你告訴他吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. Why should I? He asked you. Plus, kids usually give me heartburn.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不。我為什麼要告訴他？
是他問你的。
而且，小孩子通常讓我胃疼。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I had my favorite bean dish for breakfast today. I can't lose it. I want it to become part of me.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我今天早餐吃了我最愛的豆子料理。
我不能浪費它。
我想讓它成為我身體的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Some of it has to come out of you eventually. Poor beans. They'd be angry to be eaten by jerks like you.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
總有一部分遲早要排出來的。
可憐的豆子。
被你們這種混蛋吃掉，
它們肯定會很生氣。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Oh, right! Why don't we ask this kid?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
哦，對了！
我們何不問問這個小孩？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
What? But we can't trust him? We've just met him!
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
什麼？但我們不能信任他吧？
我們才剛認識他！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Yes, we can. People are supposed to trust each other. You didn't know that, did you? Now that he's here, he's one of us now. And I told you, everyone's born good.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
是的，我們可以信任他。
人與人之間本該互相信任。
你不知道嗎？
既然他來了，他就是我們的人了。
而且我告訴過你，
每個人生來都是善良的。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Plus, doesn't he look like he's used to rough things? He has a runner's body and keen eyes that miss nothing. I like kids like him.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
而且，他看起來像是個能吃苦的人。
他有一副奔跑者的體格，
還有敏銳的眼睛，
什麼都逃不過他的視線。
我喜歡像他這樣的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, kiddo. How'd you like to join us in business?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
嘿，小鬼。
你願意加入我們一起做生意嗎？

scripts.text: What business?
scripts.translation: 什麼生意？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look dangerous. I don't want to do anything dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們看起來很危險。
我不想做任何危險的事。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You don't? Alright, then I won't force you. Take care now. This place is dangerous. You'd better get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
是嗎？好吧，那我就不勉強你了。
保重。這裡很危險。
你最好趕緊離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Are you sure we can let him go? He's seen us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你確定我們要放他走嗎？
他看到我們了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why are you so paranoid? It's okay, kiddo. Just go. But come back if you change your mind!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你為什麼這麼多疑？
沒事的，小鬼。走吧。
但如果你改變主意，記得回來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What business?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼生意？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We've got a great plan.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我們有個絕妙的主意。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Unless you're going to explain it yourself, just shut up and let me do it!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
除非你自己解釋，否則就閉嘴讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
That's more like it. Anyway, we're going to rob the ^0000cdmine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
這就對了。總之，我們要去搶劫^0000cd米內^000000。

scripts.text: Rob the mine?
scripts.translation: 搶劫米內？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You didn't have to tell him that. You could've just asked him to get the things for us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你沒必要告訴他這些。
你完全可以讓他直接幫我們拿東西。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We can't make him do things for us without explanation. He has the right to know what he's getting himself into.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我們不能不解釋就讓他做事。
他有權知道自己要捲入什麼。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You want to take advantage of a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你想利用一個陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. I'm asking you to be in on our great plan. Anyway, you know the mine east of here? It used to belong to Gold Moon?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不。我是邀請你參與我們的絕妙計劃。
總之，你知道這裡東邊的米內嗎？它以前屬於金月？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
So, anyway, the Buffalo Bandits realized how lucrative the mine was and took up residence in there.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
所以，總之，野牛強盜們意識到這座米內利潤豐厚，就在那裡安了家。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've heard that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You have? From where?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你聽說過？從哪裡聽說的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At the sheriff's office.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在警長辦公室。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, did you just get released? So are we! In fact, we've met there. I've met most of my best friends while we were in the system.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
嘿，你剛被釋放嗎？我們也是！
事實上，我們在那裡見過面。
我在系統裡遇到了我最好的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I miss the smell of the stone floor. And the coolness.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我懷念石地板的味道。
還有那種涼爽。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I liked the food, too. I hated beans until I went to jail. All the beans I've eaten aren't half as good as those I ate in there.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我也喜歡那裡的食物。
進監獄前我討厭豆子。
我吃過的豆子都不如那裡的好。

scripts.text: Why did you go to jail?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼進監獄？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Oh, that.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
哦，那個啊。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Are you going to tell him that too?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你也要告訴他那個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why not? I loved that story. You want to hear it, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
為什麼不呢？我喜歡那個故事。
你想聽，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I'm really good with my hands, and I like fireworks. What do you think would be the best job for someone like me?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我手很巧，我喜歡煙花。
你覺得像我這樣的人最適合做什麼工作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Firecracker maker?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
爆竹製造者？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Close, but I make something stronger: ^0000cdbombs^000000. And mines are just about the best thing that could happen to people like me.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
差不多，但我做的更厲害：^0000cd炸彈^000000。而且地雷對我來說簡直是天賜之物。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
People working at the mines always need bombs. I came here, hoping I could make some money while doing what I love.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
在礦場工作的人總是需要炸彈。我來這裡，希望能一邊做自己喜歡的事，一邊賺點錢。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
But it didn't work out.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
但事情沒辦成。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And it's because of you! One night, some guys came to me and said they heard I was a bomb specialist. They demanded I donate bombs to them.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
而且都是因為你！有一天晚上，幾個人找到我，說聽說我是炸彈專家。他們要求我捐給他們一些炸彈。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
One look at them, and I knew they were the infamous ^0000cdBuffalo Bandits^000000. It was obvious why they wanted my bombs.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我看了一眼，就知道他們是臭名昭著的^0000cd野牛強盜^000000。他們為什麼想要我的炸彈，顯而易見。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
And you still gave them to them.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
而你居然還給了他們。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
What else could I do? A bunch of scary-looking buffaloes who were at least a head taller than me, mind you? Demanded I give them my bombs.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我還能怎麼辦？一群長相兇惡的野牛，而且比我高出一個頭，你懂的？他們命令我交出炸彈。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You could've stood?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你可以站著啊？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No, I couldn't have stood my ground. You weren't there. Anyway, those buffaloes used my bombs to blow up the ore train and take over the mine. Guess what happened to me afterward.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不，我沒法抵抗。你當時不在場。總之，那些野牛用我的炸彈炸燬了礦石列車，並佔領了礦場。猜猜之後我遭遇了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The sheriff traced the bombs back to me and dragged me with him.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
警長追蹤炸彈找到了我，把我帶走了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
And you got thrown in jail.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
然後你被扔進了監獄。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And guess who I met there: this guy. He was caught in the explosion that blew up the train, and those heartless buffaloes left him to die.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
猜猜我在那裡遇到了誰：這傢伙。他在炸燬列車的爆炸中被波及，那些冷血的野牛卻棄他於不顧，任其自生自滅。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And the sheriffs were no better than them. They just left him bleeding all over the cell. What could I do? I couldn't let anyone die if I could help it, so I treated him.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
警長們和他們也沒好到哪去。他們只是讓他渾身是血地躺在牢房裡。我能怎麼辦？只要力所能及，我不能讓任何人死去，所以我給他治了傷。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
He's been following me around since then.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
從那以後，他就一直跟著我。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Who? Me?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
誰？我？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Yes. Or why did you save me when I came to the mine to get even with the buffaloes? They kicked you out because of me.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
是的。不然，當我來礦場找野牛算賬時，你為什麼要救我？他們因為我的緣故把你趕了出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you get your revenge after you were released?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你出獄後復仇了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I don't want to talk about it. I made so many stupid mistakes, which wasn't like me at all. That's why we were hiding out in this dark, dank place.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我不想談那個。我犯了很多愚蠢的錯誤，這完全不像我。這就是為什麼我們躲在這個陰暗潮溼的地方。

scripts.text: So, what can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 那我該怎麼做才能幫忙？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Are you sure you want to help? Because I don't like forcing people, or sending them in harm's way. If you really want to help, then you can get some bomb materials for me.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
你確定要幫忙嗎？因為我不喜歡強迫別人，也不希望讓他們陷入危險。如果你真的想幫忙，那就幫我弄些炸彈材料吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, so you could rob the mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼，是為了搶劫礦場嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. Technically speaking, we'd ^0000cdreclaim the mine^000000. Have you seen what's going in the village? Since those buffaloes took over the mine, most of the people lost their jobs.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不。嚴格來說，我們是^0000cd奪回礦場^000000。你看到村莊裡的情況了嗎？自從那些野牛接管了礦場，大多數人都失業了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Without a job, they can't make money, and without money, they can't feed themselves. This is terrible.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
沒有工作，他們就沒錢賺；沒有錢，他們就沒飯吃。這太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I want to throw a ^0000cdfirework party inside the mine^000000 and ^0000cdscare away the bandits^000000.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我想在礦場裡舉辦一場^0000cd煙火派對^000000，並^0000cd嚇跑那些狸貓^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, Mr. Midnight, they used to be your...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，午夜先生，他們曾經是您的...

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Don't worry about him. He cut ties with them a long time ago. He has no love for those buffaloes who abandoned him. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
別擔心他。他早就和他們斷絕關係了。他對那些拋棄他的野牛毫無感情。我說得對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Well, I'll be dipped in buttermilk.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
哎呀，真是讓人哭笑不得。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
No, I'm not worried about them, but I am worried about us. If this goes wrong?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
不，我不是擔心他們，而是擔心我們。如果計劃失敗怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The sheriffs will throw us in jail if the bandits don't kill us. But it's okay. I like the beans there.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
如果狸貓沒殺了我們，警察就會把我們關進監獄。不過沒關係，我喜歡那裡的豆子。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
If this goes well, we can get out of this cesspit and I can work at the mine again. So can you.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
如果計劃順利，我們就能擺脫這個泥潭，我也可以重新在礦場工作。你也是。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Anyway, kiddo, are you sure you can help us? There are monsters inside the mine that looks like cotton balls. Hunt them, and they'll leave behind deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
總之，小傢伙，你確定能幫上忙嗎？礦場裡有一些看起來像棉花球的魔物。去獵殺它們，它們會掉落劇毒粉和炸彈粉末。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I need 10 Deadly Poison Powders and.. let me see.. 1 Explosive Powder.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我需要10個劇毒粉和...讓我看看...1個炸彈粉末。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Deadly poisonous powder? Are you going to kill them? You said you just want to scare them away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
劇毒粉？你是要殺了他們嗎？你剛才說只是想嚇跑他們。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
It's deadly only to humans and Dorams. To those Tauruses, it only causes allergic reactions, like itching and sneezing.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
它只對人類和多蘭致命。對那些野牛來說，只會引起過敏反應，比如瘙癢和打噴嚏。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I can go.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我可以去。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. You're going to get caught and ruin our plan before it even begins.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
不行。你會被抓，在計劃開始前就搞砸一切。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Ah kiddo, speaking of which, could you cull some Gasters? That'll help us set up bombs later.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
啊，小傢伙，說到這個，你能去清理一些瓦斯魔嗎？這有助於我們稍後佈置炸彈。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The buffaloes would get out of the mine when the fireworks starts, but those clumps of gas could trigger chain reaction and blow up the entire mine. Hunt 15 of them for now. Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
當煙火開始時，野牛會逃出礦場，但那些氣體團可能會引發連鎖反應，炸燬整個礦場。先去獵殺15只。你能做到嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure.

[Demon]
I asked yes or no. Oh well, I'll take that as a yes.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我問的是“是”或“否”。算了，我就當你答應了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Now, here's the lowdown: get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
那麼，情況是這樣的：去收集^0000cd10份劇毒粉和1份炸彈粉末^000000，並且^0000cd獵殺15只瓦斯魔^000000。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We'll be counting on you, kiddo! I'll repay you generously when you come back. I was able to nab a few things while in jail at the sheriff's office. Now, off you go!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
我們就指望你了，小傢伙！等你回來，我會好好報答你的。我在警長辦公室坐牢的時候順手拿了幾樣東西。現在，去吧！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, kiddo, you forgot to hunt all the Gasters. We can't have Gasters around while we work.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
讓我看看...嗯，小傢伙，你還沒把瓦斯魔都清理乾淨。我們工作的時候，周圍不能有瓦斯魔。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hunt just 15 Gasters. There's no rush. You can take your time. Just come back before the end of the day today. I want to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
只需要獵殺15只瓦斯魔。不用急，慢慢來。只要在今天結束前回來就行。我想再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 10 Deadly Poison Powders. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
讓我看看...嗯，你沒帶10份劇毒粉。那是製造炸彈所需的最低數量。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
小傢伙，你能做到的，對吧？去從瓦斯魔那裡弄10份劇毒粉和1份炸彈粉末。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 1 Explosive Powder. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
讓我看看...嗯，你沒帶1份炸彈粉末。那是製造炸彈所需的最低數量。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
小傢伙，你能做到的，對吧？去從瓦斯魔那裡弄1份炸彈粉末。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Ooh, kiddo, you got everything done! You hunted Gasters and brought what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
讓我看看...哦，小傢伙，你全都辦好了！你獵殺了瓦斯魔，還帶了我需要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
This is enough to keep me awake all night.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
這些足夠讓我整晚睡不著了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey kiddo, do you mind helping me again tomorrow? I need more than one bomb to throw a firework party.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
嘿，小傢伙，你介意明天再幫我一次嗎？我要舉辦煙火派對，需要不止一顆炸彈。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Go rest today and come back tomorrow in the morning. See ya!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔]
今天去休息吧，明天早上再來。回見！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Aww, just one look at them,
and all I want to do is sneeze...
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
唉，只要看一眼它們，
我就只想打噴嚏...

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
What are you looking at? Were you eavesdropping on me?
Get your butt outta here! Git!
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
你在看什麼？是在偷聽我說話嗎？
趕緊滾出去！混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Oh, you want to help me again.
Thanks, but I only have to patrol once a day. Why don't you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
哦，你想再幫我一次。
謝謝，但我每天只需要巡邏一次。你明天凌晨4點後再來吧？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Ah, stranger! You came to help again, right?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
啊，陌生人！你是來再次幫忙的，對吧？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Why not? Are you too busy today?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
為什麼不來？是你今天太忙了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Don't worry about your payment; I've got it covered. Just go get the job done.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
別擔心報酬，我包了。你只管把活幹完就行。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
*Groan* What do I do?
Maybe I should take a giant fan with me.
No. No, then everyone will find out.
Who's there?!
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
*呻吟* 我該怎麼辦？
也許我該帶把大扇子。
不，不行，那樣大家都會發現的。
誰在那裡？！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Mm? I'm pretty sure I haven't seen you around.
You're not one of the vigilantes.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
嗯？我肯定沒見過你。
你不是義警之一。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Wait, you're the stranger
who's been interfering with us!
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
等等，你就是那個一直在妨礙我們的陌生人！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
...Oh, that's right! Hey stranger,
have you seen the monsters
called Gasters inside the mine?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
...啊，我想起來了！嘿，陌生人，你見過礦洞裡那種叫瓦斯魔的魔物嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Gasters?
scripts.translation: 瓦斯魔？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Yes, those clumps of gas. They make me sneeze something fierce,
and turn into a weeping, drooling, sniffling mess. *Shudder*
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
對，就是那些氣體團。它們讓我噴嚏打個不停，
搞得我哭天抹淚、鼻涕橫流。*戰慄*

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Now, I've been assigned to go on patrol inside the mine, and I can't do it because of them.
But we Taurases take pride in our physical superiority. How can I tell the others that I can't do my job because I'm allergic to some gas?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
我被派去礦洞巡邏，卻因為它們無法執行任務。
但我們托拉薩族以體格強壯為榮。我怎麼能告訴別人，我因為對某種氣體過敏而做不了工作呢？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
So I'm thinking
maybe you could help me.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
所以我在想，
也許你可以幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Hunt ^FF000020 Gasters^000000 before I get in there.
I'll repay you. Please?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
在我進去之前，獵殺^FF000020只瓦斯魔^000000。
我會報答你的。拜託了？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Come on, I said I'd repay you.
Bah! Alright, then I won't force you.
But you'd better not tell anyone about this. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
拜託了，我說過會報答你的。
哼！好吧，那我就不勉強你了。
但你最好別告訴任何人這件事。聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Really? Thanks! I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
真的嗎？謝謝！我就指望你了！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Oh, and make sure no one knows about this.
That'll be bad for both of us.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
哦，還有，千萬別讓任何人知道這件事。
這對我們倆都不好。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
How many Gasters did you hunt?
I'm ready to go on patrol. Let me know when you're done.
I'll be counting on you, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
你獵殺了多少隻瓦斯魔？
我準備好去巡邏了。完成後告訴我。
我就指望你了，陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Did you hunt all of them? By the way, why are you carrying so much stuff?
Go ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
你都獵殺完了嗎？順便問一句，你為什麼攜帶這麼多東西？
先^FF0000減輕你的負重^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Did you catch them all? I'd better finish my rounds before more of them spring up.
Thanks! Here, take this.
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
你都抓完了嗎？我最好趕緊完成巡邏，免得它們又冒出來。
謝謝！拿著，這個給你。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
If you're not busy, come by tomorrow and help me again. I'll repay you.
This works for both of us, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[虛弱的食屍鬼]
如果你不忙，明天再來幫我一次吧。我會報答你的。
這對我們倆都有好處，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Hello. Are you new to this place? You should be ^FF0000at least Level 100^000000 to stay here comfortably?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你好。你是新來的嗎？想在這裡舒適地生活，至少得是^FF0000100級^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Wait, what is my husband feeding that dog? Honey! That was our dinner!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
等等，我丈夫在給那隻狗喂什麼？蜂蜜！那是我們的晚餐！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
S-sweetheart, you shouldn't be outside when it's so windy. Let's go in.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
親愛的，風這麼大，你不該在外面。我們進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Grr, I can't believe you! You're getting only half your dinner tonight!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
哼，我真不敢相信你！今晚你只能吃一半的晚餐！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
He's an angel when he's in sleep, but... sigh... I already have a headache, just thinking about what he might do when he wakes up ^FF0000after 4:00 a.m.^000000
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
他睡著的時候像個天使，但是...唉...光是想想他^FF0000凌晨4點^000000醒來後可能會做的事，我就已經頭疼了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Adventurer, thank you for coming back. We've checked all the holes Spotty dug inside the village, but we couldn't find what we were looking for. He must have taken it to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
冒險者，謝謝你回來。我們檢查了斑點在村子裡挖的所有洞，但沒找到我們要找的東西。它一定是帶去荒野了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
As I told you before, we've got something for you this time: ^0000CD1 Rock Ridge Coin^000000. Say, could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
就像我之前告訴你的，這次我們有東西給你：^0000CD1洛克裡奇硬幣^000000。請問，你能幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
We have no one else to turn to. Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我們沒人可以求助了。如果你改變主意，請回來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a {0}. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
今天斑點叼走了一件{0}。你能幫我找找嗎？雖然這東西可能很容易買到，但我不能每次斑點叼走東西都去買新的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Go outside the village and talk to my husband. He'll tell you where it might be.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
去村外找我丈夫。他會告訴你東西可能在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty would be a perfect dog if he doesn't take things out of the house. Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
如果斑點不總是叼走家裡的東西，它本來可以成為一隻完美的狗。唉...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Adventurer, we've found the ring!
After all the time we spent searching the village, we've found it inside his house.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
冒險者，我們找到戒指了！
在村子裡找了那麼久，最後竟然是在它家裡找到的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
By the way, what's that shining thing in your hand?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
順便問一下，你手裡那個閃閃發光的東西是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Oh, you want to ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first before showing it to me. Sure!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
哦，你想先^FF0000減輕負重^000000再給我看嗎？當然可以！

scripts.text: Show what's in your hand.
scripts.translation: 展示手中的物品

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
This is a Rock Ridge Coin. You can use it like money inside the village. I wasn't comfortable letting you help us for free. I'm glad you can at least have this.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
這是一枚洛克裡奇硬幣。你可以在村子裡把它當錢用。我不忍心讓你免費幫我們。很高興你至少能收下這個。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
That Rock Ridge Coin is yours. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
這枚洛克裡奇硬幣歸你了。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
And, mm... Do you mind helping us again tomorrow? Spotty keeps taking things from the house to the wasteland, and we need them back.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
還有，那個...你介意明天再幫幫我們嗎？斑點總是把家裡的東西叼到荒野去，我們需要把它們找回來。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty tired itself out and fell asleep. Could you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.? We'll have something to give you next time.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
斑點累得睡著了。你能在明天凌晨4點後再回來嗎？下次我們會給你準備一些東西。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Did you find what we asked? I can't see it because you're carrying too much stuff with you. Could you ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你找到我們要的東西了嗎？因為你攜帶的東西太多，我看不到。你能先^FF0000減輕負重^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
You've found it! Thank you so much. We've been trying to correct Spotty's behavior, and it's difficult.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你找到了！非常感謝。我們一直在試圖糾正斑點的行為，但這很難。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Here's the Rock Ridge Coin we promised. Thank you for searching the wasteland for us.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
這是我們要給你的洛克裡奇硬幣。謝謝你幫我們在荒野裡尋找。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Could you come back again? If you're not busy, you're welcome anytime after 4:00 a.m each day.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你能再回來一次嗎？如果你不忙，每天凌晨4點後隨時歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
How many times do I have to tell you to keep your dog away from our things? Do you really want me to send it away on a ship?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我要告訴你多少次，讓你把狗從我們的東西旁邊趕走？你真的想讓我把它送上船送走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Why? What did he do this time?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
為什麼？它這次又做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I can't live like this anymore! Guess what Spotty stole this time? My ring!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我受夠了這種日子了！猜猜斑點這次偷了什麼？我的戒指！

scripts.text: Check what's going on.
scripts.translation: 檢視情況

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
HONEY! Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
親愛的！你到底有沒有在聽我說話？！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
My mom gave me that ring before I left for this foreign land. I was keeping it for a rainy day, and that mongrel stole it from me!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
那是媽媽在我離開家鄉去這片異國他鄉之前送給我的。我留著以備不時之需，結果那隻雜種狗把它偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
You mean the gold ring you love? Uh-oh, Spotty is in big trouble.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
你是說那個你心愛的金戒指？哎呀，斑點這次大禍臨頭了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I tried to be understanding when it took our shoes and laundry and buried them in the ground, but no, not my ring!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
它把我們的長靴和衣服拿去埋進土裡的時候，我還試著理解它，但是不行，我的戒指絕對不行！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Sweetheart, please calm down. Is it possible you left it where he could reach it?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
親愛的，請冷靜一下。有沒有可能你把它放在它能拿到的地方了？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Are you kidding me? I never take it off except when I do the dishes or laundry,
and even then I keep it in my pocket. I dropped it just this once, and that mongrel got ahold of it!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你在開玩笑嗎？除了洗碗或洗衣服的時候，我從不摘下它，
而且即便如此，我也會把它放在口袋裡。我只有一次不小心掉了，結果就被那隻雜種狗撿走了！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
It's been two months since you quit your job, and instead of helping around the house, you've been spoiling that dog. You're responsible for its misbehavior!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你辭職已經兩個月了，不但沒幫忙做家務，還一直寵著那隻狗。它的壞毛病都是你造成的！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I saw it run to the wasteland. Go find my ring. You'd better not come back home without it!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我看見它跑向荒野了。去把我的戒指找回來。要是沒找到就別回家！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
What? I'm a miner, not a fighter? I can't go out there! You know I couldn't stay out there long enough to find my hat when it flew away in that direction.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
什麼？我是礦工，不是格鬥家？我沒法去那裡！你知道的，我的帽子被風吹到那個方向時，我連在那兒待夠時間找回來都做不到。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I don't know, and I don't care!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我不知道，我也不在乎！

scripts.text: Join the conversation.
scripts.translation: 加入對話

scripts.text: Pass.
scripts.translation: 放棄

scripts.text: - That's none of my business. I'm just going to pass. -
scripts.translation: - 這不關我的事。我只是路過。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Wah! Geez, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
哇！天哪，你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Ah, you're the adventurer who just arrived in these parts. Hah hah, don't be so surprised. I know because
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
啊，你就是剛來到這一帶的冒險者吧。哈哈，別驚訝。我知道，因為

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
you sit by the dock all day, playing with the dog. Of course, I know everyone who comes and goes.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你整天坐在碼頭邊，跟那隻狗玩。當然，我知道每一個來來去去的人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
*Clenches his teeth* Sweetheart, let's not start it right now.
Anyway, what can we do for you?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
*咬牙切齒* 親愛的，現在別開始吵了。
總之，我們能為你做些什麼？

scripts.text: Say you want to help them find the ring.
scripts.translation: 表示想幫他們找戒指

scripts.text: Say hello.
scripts.translation: 打個招呼

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Why, hello to you, too.
You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
你好啊。
你真傻。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Huh? You want to help us. Thank you, but no, thanks. We can't pay you.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
什麼？你想幫我們？謝謝，但不用了。我們付不起報酬。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
And I know for a fact that no one offers help for free anymore.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我確信，現在沒有人會免費幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Wait, honey. You should think again. You and I are too afraid of the Buffalo Bandits to go out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
等等，親愛的。你再想想。我和你都太害怕野牛強盜了，不敢去荒野。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
We have no one else to turn to, and I can't think of a better way than this. Let's take a chance on this adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我們也沒別人可以求助了，我想不出比這更好的辦法。就賭一把，相信這位冒險者吧。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
You're right, but... Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
你說得對，但是... 唉...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Mm, Adventurer, let me take back what I just said. Please help us.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
嗯，冒險者，讓我收回剛才的話。請幫幫我們。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty digs holes and buries things in them every day. If you find holes in the wasteland, please look inside them.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
Spotty每天都會在荒野挖洞並把東西埋進去。如果你在荒野發現洞，請看看裡面。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
My husband and I will look around the village, just in case. If you find something, please come back here.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
我和我丈夫會在村莊周圍找找，以防萬一。如果你找到了什麼，請回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I picked up Spotty in the wasteland. Maybe that's why he loves spending time there so much. But he never ventures so far out that he can't make it home before it's mealtime. At least, not yet.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我是在荒野撿到Spotty的。也許這就是他那麼喜歡在那裡的原因。但他從來不會走太遠，至少現在不會，他總能在飯點前趕回家。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Go out to the wasteland, and you'll see the marks that I've left on your map. You don't have to search any places beyond them.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
去荒野看看，你會看到我在地圖上留下的標記。你不需要搜尋標記以外的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Honey, you should at least follow the adventurer to the gates, so you could tell him where to look.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲夫人]
親愛的，你至少應該送冒險者到門口，告訴他該往哪裡找。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
S-should I? Uh, mm... Okay.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我...我應該嗎？呃，嗯... 好吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife said Spotty went out the back door and ran straight past the barbed-wire fence.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我妻子說Spotty從後門出去，直接穿過了鐵絲網圍欄。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
But he couldn't have gone too far because he came back to me pretty quickly. Why don't you walk along the fence and look for holes with white hair floating around them?
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
但他不可能走太遠，因為他很快就回來了。你沿著圍欄走走，找找周圍飄著白毛的洞吧？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Did you find something? Then let's go back!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
你找到什麼了嗎？那我們回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife sent me here to give you directions, but I have no idea where he might have been.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我妻子讓我來給你指路，但我完全不知道他可能去了哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Oh, right! Spotty has been shedding a lot lately. Maybe you should look for holes with white hair floating around them.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
哦，對了！Spotty最近掉毛很厲害。也許你應該找找周圍飄著白毛的洞。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
And he doesn't seem to venture out too far. It's probably because he's still young. I've marked three possible locations in the middle of your map. You don't have to look further than those locations.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
而且他似乎不會走太遠。可能是因為他還小。我在地圖中間標記了三個可能的位置。你不需要找得比那些位置更遠。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Ah, Adventurer. Shhh! Please keep your voice down: the Buffalo Bandits might hear us.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
啊，冒險者。噓！請小聲點：野牛強盜可能會聽到我們。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I've been coming here whenever I can, to catch Spotty before he takes more things out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我一有機會就來這裡，想在Spotty帶更多東西去荒野之前抓住他。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife says she'd throw him out, but she doesn't mean it. She never raises her hand no matter how angry she is with him either, and she always remembers to feed him vitamins and get him vaccinated.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我妻子說要把他趕出去，但她不是真心的。無論多生氣，她從不打他，而且總是記得給他喂維生素和打疫苗。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
She didn't say anything when I quit my job because I was too scared of the Buffalo Bandits. She's a good woman.
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
我因為太害怕野牛強盜而辭職時，她什麼也沒說。她是個好女人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
*Gasp* Buffalo Bandits!
scripts.translation:
[麥克菲先生]
*倒吸一口涼氣* 野牛強盜！

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有個洞。
裡面散落著一些白色的毛髮。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It only has wet soil inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有個洞。
裡面只有溼漉漉的土壤。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It's empty. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有個洞。
裡面是空的。 -

scripts.text: - I don't have to search farther than this. -
scripts.translation: - 我不需要再往更遠的地方找了。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有個洞。
裡面散落著一些白色的毛髮。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has something shining inside it,
scripts.translation:
- 地上有個洞。
裡面有東西在閃閃發光，

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has something inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有個洞。
裡面有些東西。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
